group.status: PB1 neutral vectors; data only; validated without loading either stack

given: The host requires the fixture contract
The provider offers an exactly equal contract
when: Negotiation runs in the declared order
then: Every required requirement matches a provision
The Binding Plan is frozen
No provider effect has occurred

given: The endpoint recognizes contractVersion 1
then: Negotiation fails closed
No provider activation begins

given: The host declares the cooling-profile requirement at strength 'required'
when: The provider offers no matching provision
then: Negotiation fails closed
No provider activation begins

given: The host declares the streaming feature at strength 'opposed'
when: The provider offers a streaming provision
then: Negotiation fails closed rather than silently ignoring the provision

given: A structurally complete contract document
when: It carries a field the contract does not declare
then: The document is rejected before negotiation
No foreign parser exception crosses

given: A requirement declares a 'strength' value
when: The value is outside the declared enumeration
then: The document is rejected rather than defaulted to a permissive strength

given: Compact identifiers are assigned only after canonical negotiation succeeds
when: A frame references a compact identifier that this binding never assigned
then: The reference does not resolve to any canonical identity
No provider effect begins

given: The portable canonical-name profile restricts segments to ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_-]
when: A contract declares a name with a segment outside that profile, or with two ':' separators
then: The reference is rejected rather than accepted as an opaque string

given: Negotiation succeeded and the binding is in state 'established'
when: A request frame arrives before the readiness signal
then: The request is refused
No provider effect occurs before readiness

given: An established binding and a ready provider
when: A request carries a record containing a sequence of records with repeated text items
then: The value conforms to the declared Shape
Sequence order is preserved exactly

given: The input is declared at command Shape version 2, which adds only the optional field 'requestedBy'
The consumer recognizes version 1
when: The consumer projects the payload to version 1
then: The unrecognized optional field is canonically ignored
The request remains eligible for authority evaluation
The projection is recorded as a mapping obligation

given: The input is declared at command Shape version 3, which adds the required field 'reason'
The consumer recognizes version 1
when: The consumer attempts to project the payload
then: The difference is not additive and projection is refused
No provider effect begins

given: The result Shape declares fragmentPolicy 'closed'
when: An outcome attaches a Fragment the negotiated Operation does not declare
then: The value is refused rather than projected away

given: 'failureMode' is an optional Text field
when: It is present and encoded as the null simple value
then: The value is refused, because absence is expressed by omission and null belongs only to unit

given: A choice Shape declares its alternatives
when: A value names an alternative outside that set
then: The category is invalid-payload rather than unsupported-kind, because the envelope kind was recognized

given: A declared payload position
when: It carries a field named 'stackTrace' or '$type'
then: The frame is rejected before semantic use
No runtime type identity is admitted

given: A control position in the envelope rather than a declared payload position
when: It carries a field named 'exception' or 'innerException'
then: The frame is rejected before semantic use
The category follows the field position

given: The host requires the fixture contract, naming its provider
Every other declaration in the two documents is equal
when: The peer answers as a different provider
then: Negotiation fails closed before any provider activation
No Binding Plan is frozen, so no plan reports a provider that did not answer
